candidate_extension_note: Original eight retained; METEK MRR family added by root before QA/model outputs as a source-access replacement candidate. No default unseen designation.
normalization: NFKC, casefold, Unicode dash folding; JSON string values AND object keys; embedded strings scanned lexically, no semantic paraphrase matching
counting: Occurrences per regex in normalized string fields/keys; narrow and broad may overlap and must not be added as independent mentions. File/field counts and scope breakdown retained; repeated exports are not independent source evidence.

legacy_qa_counts.interpretation: 5401 original QA target records; polished variants and SFT are derivatives, not extra independent questions; existing file is not proof a current checkpoint trained on it.

known_debug_exposure_registry_comparison.interpretation: Metadata alias scan of 10 known debug source groups only. JMA-1030 broad-prefix hits refer to the old JMA1030 group, not automatically JMA5200. Same publisher does not establish same family; no exact string overlap does not prove source isolation. Candidate byte/document identity comparison remains a separate root task.

limits: No candidate alias hit is not proof of complete project or pretraining non-exposure; transliterations, unnamed derivatives and unscanned backups can be missed.
